en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了 GitHub Enterprise Server sessions 在其 token 过期后显示你的 GitHub 账户已断开连接的问题；PR 和 issue 操作现在会自动刷新该 token
